item.title: Onegan!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio 5 Cylinder
  • 発売日: 2011-04-22
  • スコア: 5.86/10 (11 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おねガン！
  • 英語名: Onegan!

あらすじ

Mikoto Kitajima lives a peaceful life with her younger brother Masaya Kitajima, even though she gets teased by her friends for being a brocon. But her life get turned over with the appearance of Kinuko Sakagami.

“You are the ideal younger brother, I want you to become my younger brother”

Kinuko moves into the Kitajima house, taking advantage of the fact that their parents are travelling abroad. Moreover, she uses her financial power to expand her room right next to Masaya’s. Mikoto couldn’t just sit silent in this situation. And so, begins the fierce battle for the younger brother.
